title: ISO 27001 readiness
heading:
How ready are you for
ISO 27001?
lead: Eight quick questions across the core parts of an Information Security Management System show how close you are to a certifiable ISMS, and where the gaps are.

items.name: Leadership & scope
items.q: Is there management commitment and a defined ISMS scope?
opts: Neither is in place.
Informal support, scope not documented.
Documented scope with clear management commitment.
Scope, objectives and leadership commitment are set, resourced and reviewed.

items.name: Risk assessment & treatment
items.q: Do you have a documented risk assessment method and a risk register?
opts: No formal method.
Risks noted informally, no consistent method.
A documented method with a maintained risk register and treatment plan.
Repeatable risk management, reviewed regularly and tied to decisions.

items.name: Controls & Statement of Applicability
items.q: Have you selected and justified your Annex A controls?
opts: Controls not mapped.
Some controls in place, not documented against Annex A.
Controls selected with a Statement of Applicability.
Controls implemented, justified, and evidenced against Annex A.

items.name: Policies & procedures
items.q: Are your security policies and procedures documented and actually used?
opts: Little or nothing documented.
Some documents exist but are not followed.
Documented policies that people follow.
A complete, version-controlled set that is understood and enforced.

items.name: Asset & access management
items.q: Do you manage an asset inventory and control access to information?
opts: No inventory or access process.
Partial inventory, informal access control.
Maintained inventory with role-based access control.
Full inventory, least-privilege access, reviewed and logged.

items.name: Supplier & third-party security
items.q: Is the security of suppliers and third parties assessed and managed?
opts: Not considered.
Considered occasionally, no consistent process.
Suppliers assessed with security expectations in contracts.
Ongoing third-party risk management with regular review.

items.name: Incident management & continuity
items.q: Do you have incident response and business continuity in place?
opts: Neither is documented.
Informal, untested arrangements.
Documented incident and continuity plans.
Plans that are tested and improved after exercises or events.

items.name: Internal audit & improvement
items.q: Do you run internal audits and act on findings to improve?
opts: No internal audit activity.
Ad hoc checks, findings not tracked.
Scheduled internal audits with tracked corrective actions.
A mature audit and continual improvement cycle with management review.
